architecture.headline: System Architecture & Engineering Standards
architecture.subheadline: Core backend and full-stack design principles applied across production deployments.

pillars.title: Stateless JWT & Role-Based Access Control
pillars.description: Decoupled client-server deployments secured with SimpleJWT access/refresh tokens, automated Axios authorization interceptors, and role-level endpoint guards (Admin vs. Employee scopes).

pillars.title: Idempotent & Atomic Database Operations
pillars.description: Bulk write workflows—such as department-wide attendance logging—use Django ORM's update_or_create batching and composite unique constraints to eliminate duplicate record anomalies.

pillars.title: Normalized Relational Schemas
pillars.description: Structured relational data models in PostgreSQL and MySQL enforcing strict ForeignKey and OneToOne constraints, user-isolated queryset filtering, and optimized query lookups.

pillars.title: Acoustic DSP & BiLSTM Neural Pipeline
pillars.description: Audio signals are preprocessed into Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs) using Librosa and classified through a Bidirectional LSTM network in TensorFlow.

blueprints.name: Full-Stack REST & RBAC Request Pipeline
blueprints.summary: End-to-end request lifecycle connecting a React client (Vercel) to a Django REST API (Render) and PostgreSQL (Neon).

nodes.title: React + Axios Interceptor
nodes.detail: Attaches Bearer JWT automatically and routes users to role-specific workspaces.

nodes.title: Django REST + SimpleJWT
nodes.detail: Validates token signatures, resolves UserProfile roles, and enforces endpoint permissions.

nodes.title: Serializers & Batch ORM
nodes.detail: Validates payloads and executes atomic create/update operations via Django ORM.

nodes.title: PostgreSQL / MySQL
nodes.detail: Enforces relational integrity, unique constraints, and persistent transaction storage.

projects.name: Employee Attendance & HR Management System
projects.kind: Full-Stack ERP • Django REST Framework, React & PostgreSQL
projects.metrics: Bulk Attendance Engine • Stateless JWT & RBAC • Auto Employee ID
projects.problem: Organizations managing daily attendance manually face slow one-by-one data entry, duplicate attendance records on the same date, and disconnected employee login accounts.
projects.solution: Built a role-based HR and attendance system using Django REST Framework and React. Engineered a Fast Bulk Attendance module to mark or update an entire department in one click, paired with Admin-only user provisioning and an Employee Self-Service Portal.
projects.architectureHighlight: SimpleJWT authentication with Axios interceptors, OneToOne UserProfile-to-Employee linking, and idempotent Attendance.objects.update_or_create batch processing on Neon PostgreSQL.
contribution: Engineered the bulk attendance REST API and interactive React sheet for one-click department-wide Present/Absent/Late logging
Implemented deterministic Employee ID generation (Company Code + 4 digits + name prefix) with live preview and backend fallback
Built Admin-only user registration (/api/register/) linking authentication credentials directly to employee records
Developed the Employee Self-Service dashboard for viewing personal attendance metrics and submitting leave applications
projects.outcome: Deployed in production on Vercel (React frontend), Render (Django REST API), and Neon Serverless PostgreSQL.

projects.name: Personal Expense & Financial Tracker
projects.kind: Full-Stack Web Application • React & Django REST API
projects.metrics: JWT Protected Ledger • Category Analytics • Cloud Deployed
projects.problem: Individuals need a secure, structured web interface to record daily expenses, categorize transactions, and review monthly spending patterns across devices.
projects.solution: Developed a full-stack financial ledger combining a responsive React.js dashboard with a Django REST backend, JWT authentication, and per-user data isolation.
projects.architectureHighlight: Enforces per-user queryset filtering at the API view layer so authenticated users can only access or modify their own financial records.
contribution: Built the full-stack application end-to-end connecting a React.js frontend with a Django REST API backend
Implemented stateless JWT login and protected route guards to secure personal financial data
Designed RESTful CRUD endpoints for expense logging, category filtering, and summary aggregation
Created an interactive dashboard for visualizing transaction history and spending distribution
projects.outcome: Live production deployment hosted on Vercel with source code available on GitHub.

projects.name: Bird Species Classification via Audio Analysis
projects.kind: Deep Learning & Signal Processing • TensorFlow & Librosa
projects.metrics: 85% Classification Accuracy • MFCC Feature Extraction • BiLSTM Network
projects.problem: Visual identification of bird species in dense habitats is unreliable compared to acoustic monitoring of their calls.
projects.solution: Developed an audio classification pipeline that extracts Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs) from raw recordings using Librosa and classifies species calls with a Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM) neural network.
projects.architectureHighlight: Transforms raw audio waveforms into normalized spectral feature tensors processed sequentially by Bidirectional LSTM layers.
contribution: Designed and trained the Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM) model in TensorFlow for sequential audio classification
Built the audio preprocessing pipeline using Librosa for noise trimming and MFCC spectral extraction
Evaluated model accuracy and tuned dropout regularization across multi-species audio datasets
projects.outcome: Achieved 85% validation accuracy across recorded bird call datasets.
